forkjoinpool-work-stealing-concept.title: Understand ForkJoinPool work stealing
forkjoinpool-work-stealing-concept.short: Let worker threads take queued tasks from one another
forkjoinpool-work-stealing-concept.summary: ForkJoinPool schedules fork/join tasks across workers and uses work stealing to keep available workers productive.
forkjoinpool-work-stealing-concept.why: It is the execution engine behind several parallel Java facilities and is designed for many small tasks that can split and join.
forkjoinpool-work-stealing-concept.tips: Avoid long unmanaged blocking in compute-heavy fork/join tasks; use an appropriate dedicated executor when workload isolation matters.

bytebuffer-readonly-view-concept.title: Expose ByteBuffer data through a read-only view
bytebuffer-readonly-view-concept.short: Share buffer content without allowing writes through that view
bytebuffer-readonly-view-concept.summary: asReadOnlyBuffer creates a buffer view that shares content with the original buffer but rejects mutating operations.
bytebuffer-readonly-view-concept.why: A read-only view can express an API boundary where consumers may inspect bytes without writing through their reference.
bytebuffer-readonly-view-concept.tips: The content is shared, so changes made through another writable view can still become visible.

collections-disjoint.title: Test collections for disjointness
collections-disjoint.short: Check whether two collections share no equal elements
collections-disjoint.summary: Collections.disjoint returns true when the two supplied collections have no elements in common.
collections-disjoint.why: It states an overlap check directly instead of requiring a manual nested search or temporary intersection.
collections-disjoint.tips: Performance depends on the collection implementations; use sets when repeated membership checks dominate a hot path.

arrays-mismatch.title: Find the first differing array element
arrays-mismatch.short: Locate the first index where two arrays differ
arrays-mismatch.summary: Arrays.mismatch returns the first differing index, or -1 when the compared arrays are equal over their full lengths.
arrays-mismatch.why: It avoids a hand-written comparison loop when diagnostics or prefix comparison needs the first mismatch position.
arrays-mismatch.tips: Use the overload for the correct primitive or reference array type and check for -1 before using the returned index.

read-only-buffer-exception.title: ReadOnlyBufferException
read-only-buffer-exception.short: Do not mutate a read-only NIO buffer view
read-only-buffer-exception.summary: ReadOnlyBufferException is thrown when a mutating buffer operation is attempted on a read-only buffer.
read-only-buffer-exception.why: Read-only views deliberately preserve access to shared content while blocking writes through that particular view.
read-only-buffer-exception.tips: Keep a writable buffer reference for producers and pass read-only views to code that should only consume data.

provider-not-found-exception.title: ProviderNotFoundException
provider-not-found-exception.short: Use a file-system URI scheme with an installed provider
provider-not-found-exception.summary: ProviderNotFoundException indicates that no installed file-system provider supports the requested operation or URI scheme.
provider-not-found-exception.why: NIO file-system creation and lookup delegate scheme-specific behavior to installed FileSystemProvider implementations.
provider-not-found-exception.tips: Check the URI scheme and runtime provider availability before attempting to create provider-specific file systems.

record-accessor-return-type-error.title: A record accessor must match its component type
record-accessor-return-type-error.short: Return exactly the declared record component type
record-accessor-return-type-error.summary: An explicitly declared record accessor must have the same return type as its corresponding record component.
record-accessor-return-type-error.why: Record accessors are part of the fixed API derived from the record header and cannot replace that signature with a wider return type.
record-accessor-return-type-error.tips: Keep the accessor return type identical to the component type; use another method name for a transformed or generalized view.

switch-expression-no-result-error.title: Every switch-expression path must produce a result
switch-expression-no-result-error.short: Yield a value from block-form switch expression arms
switch-expression-no-result-error.summary: A switch expression cannot complete a selected arm without producing the value required by the surrounding expression.
switch-expression-no-result-error.why: Unlike a switch statement, a switch expression has a value, so every normally completing path must supply one.
switch-expression-no-result-error.tips: Use an expression after -> directly, or use yield inside a block arm.

auxiliary-class-access-warning.title: Auxiliary class access warning
auxiliary-class-access-warning.short: Put top-level classes in source files that match their names
auxiliary-class-access-warning.summary: javac's auxiliaryclass lint can warn when code accesses a top-level class from a source file whose name does not match that class.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.why: Depending on auxiliary classes hidden in another source file makes source discovery and separate compilation less predictable.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.tips: Prefer one externally used top-level class per matching .java source file.

arrays-binarysearch-unsorted-trap.title: Binary search requires sorted input
arrays-binarysearch-unsorted-trap.short: Sort an array under the same ordering before searching it
arrays-binarysearch-unsorted-trap.summary: Arrays.binarySearch assumes its input is sorted according to the ordering used by the selected overload.
arrays-binarysearch-unsorted-trap.why: The call still compiles for unsorted input, but its result is not defined as a valid lookup result for that data.
arrays-binarysearch-unsorted-trap.tips: Maintain sorted data when searches are frequent, or sort before searching when mutation has disturbed the order.
